profile_text.body:
Space Exploration Technologies Corp, doing business as SpaceX, designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft. The company states it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. The available material does not identify any AI products.

The company is headquartered in Starbase, Texas, and is a public company with ticker SPCX and CIK 0001181412. It is also known as Space Exploration Technologies Corp and Space Exploration Techn-CL A. Texas records list 126 legal exposure entries for the company.
